activity_summary: From a rise in the afternoon you saw London's smoke lying flat and brown along the river, from Westminster to the Tower. Three weeks ago you walked out of it with your head down. Hobbins said she wants everything by Thursday. The string did not pause, and nor did you.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Named the city, and what it wants.

facets.activity: Saw London's smoke from the rise

quotes.speaker: thomas_hobbins
quotes.text: There she is. Dear, dirty, and wants everything by Thursday.
